channel.title: Yurii Serhiichuk — Blog
channel.description: Articles on cloud architecture, DevOps, FinOps, and AI engineering.

item.title: Your llms.txt guide is out of date: what v2 changed
item.description: llmstxt.org published v2 in August 2026. Two things the popular guides tell you are no longer true, and the spec moved toward what Astro said on its way out.

item.title: Building an Autonomous SRE Agent with Google ADK and the Antigravity SDK
item.description: A runnable autonomous SRE agent: Google ADK for multi-agent diagnosis, the Antigravity SDK for a deny-by-default runtime. Runs locally, zero GCP credentials.

item.title: Open Knowledge Format — portable digital map of your data as code
item.description: Google's Open Knowledge Format turns data knowledge into portable markdown. I built OKF Skills — six vendor-neutral connectors, a visualizer, and an MCP server.

item.title: Cloud Workstations: building reusable development environments in cloud — Part 2
item.description: How to customize your Cloud Workstations environment and improve developer productivity: custom base images with Code OSS and WebStorm, built by Pulumi.

item.title: Cloud Workstations: building reusable development environments in cloud
item.description: A minimal Google Cloud Workstations setup with Pulumi, TypeScript and Bun: VPC, cluster, config and a first workstation, from project bootstrap to pulumi up.

item.title: Keeping your gists in sync with the source repository
item.description: Gists go stale the moment the source file moves on. A GitHub Action that re-uploads them on every release, so the shared copy never drifts.

item.title: Google Skills — an evolution of online learning
item.description: Qwiklabs to Skills Boost to Google Skills: what changed across three generations of Google's learning platform, and what the gamified rebuild actually adds.

item.title: Is the future of autonomous AI agents already here? Jules API and MCP
item.description: Google shipped a public API for Jules. I put an MCP server on top of it so any AI tool can kick off autonomous Jules coding sessions.

item.title: From Autopilot to Standard GKE: The Key to 15x Cheaper Istio
item.description: Istio proxy costs for a 10-node GKE cluster reduced from $3065 to $185 per month by moving from GKE Autopilot to GKE Standard with Istio Ambient.

item.title: Going beyond standard HTTP timeouts in GCP Workflows — the practice
item.description: Deploying a fully functional App Engine Tasks Runner and the GCP infrastructure around it, so Workflows can drive HTTP calls that outlive the standard timeouts.

item.title: Going beyond standard HTTP timeouts in GCP Workflows — the theory
item.description: GCP Workflows' HTTP connector times out at 30 minutes. Why Pub/Sub and Cloud Run don't help, and how App Engine targets on Cloud Tasks get you 24 hours.
